bitsweave 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Enables agents to interact with the BitsWeave MCP server for reading shared project context and saving durable work.
- Connects to https://bitsweave.com/api/mcp using Streamable HTTP with integrated OAuth flow.
- Guides users to check plugin activation and restart OpenClaw gateway if tools are not available.
